say:1:1123102001:1.text: You and I both know, Kruger. Hmph, perhaps it's now appropriate to say... Chief Kruger.
say:1:1123102001:1.source_cn: 你和我都清楚，克鲁格大人。\n哼，也许现在应该说……克...

say:2:1123102002:1.text: Not dying on the battlefield is already tragic. Remaining here only brings us further humiliation.
say:2:1123102002:1.source_cn: 不能战死沙场已经是我们的遗憾了，继续留在这里只会让我们...

say:4:1123102003:1.text: Calm down, Kepa. Chief Kruger means no harm...
say:4:1123102003:1.source_cn: 冷静点，奎帕。\n克鲁格族长没有恶意……

say:6:1123102004:1.text: No harm? Then why did Hashir leave? You know the reason.
say:6:1123102004:1.source_cn: 没有恶意？哈什尔是怎么离开的，你应该清楚的吧。

say:9:1123102006:1.text: Everyone, I understand your grievances. Please return for now. I will provide an explanation in due course.
say:9:1123102006:1.source_cn: 各位，我明白你们的诉求。请先回去吧，我会给你们一个交代。

say:14:1123102008:1.text: They want to uphold tradition and live as they wish.
say:14:1123102008:1.source_cn: 他们想要遵循传统，按照希望的那样生活……

choice_prompt:15:1123102008.text: They want to uphold tradition and live as they wish.
choice_prompt:15:1123102008.source_cn: 他们想要遵循传统，按照希望的那样生活……

say:17:1123102011:1.text: To come into old age is considered shameful in the Grimmaw Clan. Ever since the first elder chose self-exile, this twisted belief has taken root.
say:17:1123102011:1.source_cn: 衰老在黑嚎氏族被视为一种耻辱，自第一个老人选择自我放逐...

say:18:1123102012:1.text: In time, the elders have regarded exile as a source of pride. Perhaps I shouldn't have consented to Hashir's exile.
say:18:1123102012:1.source_cn: 慢慢这些老人竟视放逐为荣誉。\n也许我不该默许哈什尔的放逐。

choice_prompt:19:1123102012.text: In time, the elders have regarded exile as a source of pride. Perhaps I shouldn't have consented to Hashir's exile.
choice_prompt:19:1123102012.source_cn: 慢慢这些老人竟视放逐为荣誉。\n也许我不该默许哈什尔的放逐。

say:20:1123102013:1.text: A respected shaman... His deeds warrant the care and support of the Grimmaw Clan, yet he continues to insist on isolation.
say:20:1123102013:1.source_cn: 一位在氏族中较有威望的萨满，他的功绩足够安享黑嚎的供养...

say:21:1123102014:1.text: He paid no heed to my refusal and left in secret. Despite my repeated attempts to visit him, I was turned away each time.
say:21:1123102014:1.source_cn: 他最后竟无视我的拒绝，私下离开了。我曾数次拜访他，但都...

say:22:1123102015:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know this is a sudden request, but would you please visit this elder for me?

say:25:1123102018:1.text: If Hashir can change his mind, perhaps others may change as well.
say:25:1123102018:1.source_cn: 如果哈什尔的想法有所改观，也许能影响更多人接受改变。

say:27:1123102019:0.text: He lives in a tent in seclusion on a nearby mountain. Here are some provisions. Please deliver them to him.
say:27:1123102019:0.source_cn: 他隐居在附近的山上，自己搭了一个帐篷居住。这里是一些补...

say:29:1123102017:1.text: I must reassure the three who just left, so I'm counting on you!
say:29:1123102017:1.source_cn: 我得先去安抚刚刚的三位，所以拜托你了！
say:29:1123102017:1.male: I must reassure the three who just left, so I'm counting on you!

say:30:1123102010:1.text: In the Grimmaw Clan, ultimate honor is achieved by falling in battle.
say:30:1123102010:1.source_cn: 在黑嚎氏族中，最高的荣誉永远是战死沙场。
